changes.before: The Litany of Loreto as Poland prays it: the Roman text with one invocation of its own. In 1962 the Roman text ended with Regína pacis, and in Poland Regína Polóniæ followed it. To the text attested by the 1952 Enchiridion Indulgentiarum the Holy See added Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) and, in 2020, Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium, and beside them Poland says Regína Polóniæ, approved for it in 1920. Mater misericórdiæ had already been granted to Poland in 2014, and the letter of 2020 moved it to the place it holds here, after Mater Ecclésiæ.
changes.after: The litany follows the order used in Poland. The last Marian invocation in the 1952 Roman edition is Regína pacis. In Poland it is followed by Regína Polóniæ. In a letter of 1920 Archbishop Józef Bilczewski recorded the grant permitting this invocation. The Holy See permitted the addition of Mater Ecclésiæ in 1980 and introduced Regína famíliæ in 1995. In 2020 it added Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium. Poland had already received permission in 2014 to say “Mother of mercy” after “Mother of divine grace”. The text published by the Polish bishops in 2020 places it after “Mother of the Church”.
